subject: Archaeology
title: The Brothels and Bathhouses of Pompeii
description: A quick win: understand The Brothels and Bathhouses of Pompeii.

hook.text: Pompeii had at least 25 brothels for a city of 11,000 people. Romans had a very different view of vice.

buildup.text: The main brothel, the Lupanare, had stone beds and explicit frescoes serving as a menu for clients.

discovery.text: Public bathhouses served as social clubs. Rich and poor bathed together in heated pools with mosaic floors.

twist.text: Bath water was rarely changed. Archaeologists found evidence of parasites — Roman hygiene was less clean than it looked.

climax.text: These buildings reveal a society where public and private life blurred in ways modern visitors find surprising.

punchline.text: Romans bathed together, socialized naked, and called it civilization.

quiz.question: What did archaeological analysis of Roman bathhouses reveal?
options: They were strictly segregated by social class
Bath water was rarely changed and contained parasites
Only wealthy citizens were allowed to use the heated pools
